page.overview:
Who is Gerry Harding?

Dr. Gerry Harding is the Chief Veterinarian of Jurassic Park. He is a minor character in Jurassic Park, being portrayed by the film's producer Gerald R. Molen. Molen was 57 at the time and had graying hair.

In the 1993 film, he was first met by the endorsment team while tending to a sick Triceratops that had been suffering from an unknown illness every six weeks. According to surrounding material (i.e. Jurassic Park: The Game, and The Lost World) has been married multiple times and has two daughters, Jessica and Sarah Harding.

In , he was seen treating a Triceratops suffering from a strange disease. He and Ellie would look into the dinosaur's health, with Ellie noting the dinosaur's dialated pupils. Later, he drove Ellie back to the Visitor Center in his Gas-powered Jeep. After that, he left for the last boat to the mainland.

It was stated in the website that apparently Harding had been suspicious of Nedry and had at some point found he was responsible for the theft of 15 embryos.Ross S. (June 11, 2018). [https://www.dinosaurprotectiongroup.com/investigation-the-old-park.html "Investigation: The Old Park"]. Dinosaur Protection Group.
